items.title: 비쌀수록 잘 팔린다더니..."이제 아무도 안 사" 추락하는 명품
items.summary: Kyunghyang Shinmun business feature on the luxury sector's demand crisis, naming Gucci as posting twelve consecutive quarters of sales decline, with H1 2026 revenue down 9% YoY to 2.757 billion euros. Cites McKinsey data that over 80% of 2019-2023 luxury growth came from price hikes rather than volume, and frames Gucci's new lower-priced Mercato bag (about 27% below the brand's average bag price) as a direct response to eroded consumer trust; notes roughly 60 million consumers have exited the category for cheaper indulgences like cosmetics.

items.title: 古驰连续十季下滑后大动作：Demna新设计+降价30%+管理层重组，能否翻身？
items.summary: Sina trade analysis surveying Gucci's simultaneous turnaround levers after ten straight quarters of decline: Demna's deconstructivist, Balenciaga-inflected debut collection drew polarized consumer reaction; China price cuts of roughly 30% (slightly smaller 20-25% cuts in Europe/North America) mark a retreat from outlet-dependent discounting toward premium-retail focus; CEO Luca de Meo publicly conceded past pricing misjudgments, ex-Bottega Veneta chief Francesca Bellettini became Gucci president, and the group closed 75 stores globally in 2025 (about 40% of them Gucci).

items.title: 구찌, 2026 가을·겨울 아이웨어 새 시선
items.summary: Money Today covers Gucci's FW2026 eyewear campaign, portrait photography of subjects in contemplative moments, reinterpreting the Double G logo and Horsebit motif on black acetate frames and round sunglasses. Art direction by Ricardo Zanola, photography by Mark Seliger. Standard activation/marketing coverage with no critical framing.

items.title: 古驰悄悄降价
items.summary: Jiemian News reports Gucci quietly cut China prices on bags and apparel by 27-40% (Mercato tote 25,500 to 20,000 yuan; Ophidia mini bucket bag to 8,700 yuan; canvas dresses and wool cardigans down about 30%). Kering's CEO attributed the move to diminished industry-wide pricing power after products were priced beyond target-customer willingness to pay. Social-media reaction described as unsurprised, with commenters noting Louis Vuitton and Miu Miu have made similar quiet cuts; Gucci did not officially comment.

items.title: 「グッチ」がメンズ向けスモールレザーグッズを発売 日本限定ウオレットも
items.summary: WWD Japan reports Gucci's men's small leather goods drop from the Gucci Primavera FW2026 collection, releasing October 1, including a Japan-exclusive perforated-GG-leather zip wallet at 143,000 yen and coin/card cases from 41,800-78,100 yen, sold via Gucci directly-operated stores and the official Japan online store.

items.title: [경제] "비쌀수록 잘 팔린다더니"..."이제 아무도 안 사" 추락하는 명품
items.summary: Korean gaming/general community (Ruliweb) repost of the Kyunghyang luxury-decline article, highlighting Gucci's twelve straight quarters of falling sales and LVMH's roughly 35% share-price drop this year. Top comment argues luxury brands lost appeal once consumers learned goods are made by developing-country factory labor rather than artisans, questioning why anyone still buys them -- representative of skeptical/critical community sentiment toward the category including Gucci.

items.title: 古驰大震荡：Demna首秀、降价30%、关店百间，能否重回巅峰？
items.summary: Weibo long-form post/thread summarizing Gucci's compounding upheaval -- Demna's debut, roughly 30% China price cuts, and closure of over 100 stores nationwide (down to 478) -- framed as an open question of whether the brand can recover past dominance. Representative of the Chinese social-media narrative treating Gucci's repricing and retail contraction as a single connected turnaround story rather than isolated moves.

items.title: Gucci暴跌40%破"只涨不跌"铁律！现在入手还是继续观望？
items.summary: Weibo consumer-advice post discussing whether to buy now or wait, after Gucci's up-to-40% China price cuts broke the long-standing luxury norm of prices only ever rising. Reflects retail/resale-market chatter among prospective buyers debating value retention and timing, with an implicit undercurrent that the cuts have unsettled buyers' trust in Gucci as a store of value.

items.title: 명품 중고, 대충 팔면 손해 확정이에요
items.summary: Korean Threads post giving secondhand-luxury resale tips (condition grading, seasonal demand, platform verification), using Gucci and comparable brands as reference points for how much resale prices can diverge (30-40%) depending on condition and completeness. General secondhand-market advice content rather than brand-specific news, but indicative of active Korean SNS discussion around luxury resale value amid the pricing-trust narrative.

items.title: 古驰国内和国外价差有多少？3大维度拆解+最新降价动态
items.summary: Sina Finance consumer-facing explainer breaking down Gucci's remaining domestic-vs-overseas (Europe) price gap across three dimensions after the September repricing round, noting the gap has narrowed from a historical 30-40% premium to under 30% for many styles post-cuts, still leaving a partial incentive for daigou (personal shopper) cross-border purchasing.
